Methodology and data sources

Data gathered 2026-06-06 by a per-folder sweep of project-blueprints/ (plus the House Monitor folder under .Adam's Personal Projects): version comments from instructions files, "Context Files and When to Use Them" sections, skill-name greps, knowledge-base/ path greps, project-launch.md Block 2 checklists, and blueprint-summary.md tool assessments. Registry (context-agent-registry.md) used as the project list and status source. "Export-ready" = has instructions.md + project-launch.md + context files resolvable on disk, per the cowork-snapshot-exporter skill's packaging requirements. Instructions text deliberately excluded from every snapshot. Same-day backfill (2026-06-06): 4 launch files created (Personal Assistant, The Architect, Deep Research, System Monitor), House Monitor instructions.md v1.0 + launch file created, The Customer instructions + 5 context files synced into its blueprint folder with a new changelog.md. Point-in-time: any version bump invalidates the affected card.
